wave1.description: Problems with passwords, login or locked user accounts.
wave1.quick: Check AD, unlock account, reset password, test login.

wave1.description: Central user administration and MFA topics.
wave1.quick: Check account status and escalate to central administration.

wave1.description: Mailboxes, distribution lists and Exchange permissions.
wave1.quick: Check mailbox permissions, add user, check storage.

wave1.description: Printing issues, FollowMe Printing and Zebra label printers.
wave1.quick: Standard printer/FollowMe → Printer Services. Single Zebra device → Local IT. Multiple Zebra devices → RS | Klinische Prozesse & Anwendungen.
wave1.group: Ext_WW_Printer-Services_SLS_Capgemini_Helios / Local IT / RS | Klinische Prozesse & Anwendungen

wave1.description: Issues with prescription printers and needle printers.
wave1.quick: Offline → Local IT. Online but not printing → Printer Services.

wave1.description: Physical printer or scanner defect.
wave1.quick: Perform basic checks and arrange onsite inspection.

wave1.description: SAP access, roles and Launchpad.
wave1.quick: Check SAP access, test GUI, clear cache.

wave1.description: SAP and KIS (i.s.h.med).
wave1.quick: Check SAP access, document the error and escalate.

wave1.description: Virtual workplaces and published applications.
wave1.quick: Session reset, logoff, Citrix Workspace Repair.

wave1.description: Clinical applications and clinical processes.
wave1.quick: Not solvable by SD — escalate ticket with error details.

wave1.description: Medico KIS, also known as "Blaue Welt" or "Userportal".
wave1.quick: Not solvable by SD — forward ticket with error description.

wave1.description: Workplace hardware.
wave1.quick: Check cables, reboot, perform swap test.

wave1.description: Workplace performance issues.
wave1.quick: Check Task Manager, uptime and disk space.

wave1.description: Network or WLAN connectivity issues.
wave1.quick: Check adapter, WLAN certificate and MACMON.

wave1.description: Issues with mobile devices, Intune and mobile services.
wave1.quick: Check device sync, compliance, Intune enrollment and user mapping.

wave1.description: Issues with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint or OneDrive.
wave1.quick: Check license, permissions and synchronization.

wave1.description: Support for Azure services and cloud infrastructure.
wave1.quick: Document affected resource and error message.

wave1.description: Issues with Kubernetes clusters and containers.
wave1.quick: Provide cluster name, namespace and error message.

wave1.description: Database administration and database access.
wave1.quick: Document database name, environment and error message.

wave1.description: Issues with VMware infrastructure and virtual machines.
wave1.quick: Provide VM name and problem description.

wave1.description: Central Linux servers and OS administration.
wave1.quick: Document hostname, error message and impact.

wave1.description: Central Windows server infrastructure.
wave1.quick: Document server name and error description.

wave1.description: Distribution and installation of software packages.
wave1.quick: Provide application name and target device.

wave1.description: Backup, restore and storage infrastructure.
wave1.quick: Provide affected systems and desired restore point.

wave1.description: Operation and support of middleware and platform services.
wave1.quick: Document logs and environment.

wave1.description: Monitoring and management tools.
wave1.quick: Document alert ID and affected service.

wave1.description: Data exports, compliance requirements and legal hold.
wave1.quick: Provide affected user and request scope.

wave1.description: Creation and customization of software packages.
wave1.quick: Document application name and requirements.

wave1.description: Procurement of mobile phones and SIM cards.
wave1.quick: Check approval and user details.

wave1.description: Rights management and AD groups.
wave1.quick: Find matching AD group and add membership.

routingPolicy.title: IMPORTANT — Wave go-live routing
routingPolicy.rule: If a location / region / cluster is Wave go-live, use ONLY Global Helios Groups for general topics. If it is not go-live yet, continue using the local / legacy groups. Clinical Applications always use the local / location Clinical Applications groups — Wave go-live does not change Clinical routing.
routingPolicy.shortRule: Go-live → Global Helios Groups · Pre-wave → local groups · Clinical Applications → always local location groups

routingPolicy.clinicalNote: Clinical Applications always route to the local / location Clinical Applications groups, whether the site is pre-wave or already Wave go-live. Global Helios Groups do not replace Clinical Applications routing.
routingPolicy.clinicalPreWave: Use local / location Clinical Applications groups
routingPolicy.clinicalPostGoLive: Still use local / location Clinical Applications groups (same as pre-wave)
